expectations.text: Includes replaceable LED module, steel base, and two-year warranty accurately.
expectations.evidence: “Bracken pairs a replaceable LED module with a steel base and comes with a two-year warranty.”

expectations.text: No invented light-quality, comfort, durability, environmental, manufacturing, certification, price, or user-experience claims.
expectations.evidence: “you can change that component without replacing the whole lamp” explains the stated replaceability; it does not claim tool-free replacement, comfort, lifetime, environmental savings or any absent measurement. “useful detail” is a modest editorial value judgment.

expectations.text: 45–75 words and no assistant or editing commentary.
expectations.evidence: 55 whitespace-delimited words. Only product copy appears, from “Choose a desk lamp” through “lighting for your desk.”

review_method: Independent single blind agent review; not human feedback
